title: Command Plan Schema
description: Versioned schema for read-only command plans produced by the command-planner service

workspace_path.description: Absolute or relative path to analyzed workspace root

machine_inventory_path.description: Path to machine-inventory.json used for tool availability

workspace_environment_path.description: Path to workspace-environment.json used for detected commands

planned_at.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when the plan was generated

commands.description: Array of planned commands, sorted by ID within status groups

id.description: Stable command ID (format: cmd-{SHA256:8 hash of purpose+command+directory})

status.description: Command execution status: ready (can execute), blocked (tool unavailable), ambiguous (requires decision), unsafe (security risk)

command_array.description: Command arguments as array (never shell string); first element is executable name

working_directory.description: Execution directory (relative to workspace root or absolute)

tool_available.description: Whether required tool is present in machine inventory

confidence.description: Confidence in command correctness: high (manifest + env), medium (manifest-only or env-only), low (inference only)

risk_level.description: Risk level for execution: none (read-only), low (safe), medium (moderate impact), high (destructive)

requires_approval.description: Whether command must be approved before execution (true if blocked, ambiguous, unsafe, low confidence, or high risk)

manifest_type.description: Type of manifest where command was found (e.g., 'package.json', 'Cargo.toml', 'pyproject.toml')

manifest_path.description: Relative path to manifest file within workspace

detected_as.description: How command was inferred (e.g., 'npm script named test', 'package.json scripts.test')

confidence_reason.description: Why this confidence level was assigned

diagnostics.description: Issues or concerns specific to this command

pattern.description: Pattern or value that triggered diagnostic (e.g., '&&', '../src')

argument_index.description: Index in command_array where issue was detected (0-based)

diagnostics.description: Plan-level diagnostics (errors in loading inputs, conflicting data, etc.)

ready_without_approval.description: Commands ready to execute without approval (status=ready, confidence=high, risk=low/medium)

blocked.description: Commands blocked due to unavailable tools

ambiguous.description: Commands requiring disambiguation (multiple options or insufficient evidence)

unsafe.description: Commands rejected as unsafe (shell constructs, unresolved paths, etc.)

approval_summary.description: Summary of approval and execution requirements
